notes: A finish_reason outside OpenAI's five values raises a pydantic ValidationError (ChatCompletion.model_validate), so the response is lost. Also reproduced on 1.33.3. The same error reaches provider='openai' pointed at Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (ollama-openai).

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama sends an id on each tool call, but the ollama Python client (0.6.3, latest) has no field for it, so any-llm's native provider generates UUIDs instead (providers/ollama/utils.py).

any-llm documents the fallback: a done_reason outside stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter and function_call is reported as stop (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/18ed82b8ae89db560bf0b1ec8bccb752fc0e2b5d/src/any_llm/providers/ollama/utils.py#L33-L46). The caller cannot tell an unfamiliar reason from a normal stop.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores max_completion_tokens (v0.40.3), and any-llm's openai provider sends only that name (providers/openai/base.py), so the limit never applies. The root cause is in Ollama; the PR listed adds the field. The check reads the request any-llm sends, so the cell stays WRONG after Ollama's fix and re-recording does not change it: retire or rewrite the scenario when that release ships.

any-llm documents the fallback: a Gemini finish reason without an OpenAI counterpart (OTHER, LANGUAGE, MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL and any unfamiliar value) maps to None and a complete response then reports stop (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/18ed82b8ae89db560bf0b1ec8bccb752fc0e2b5d/src/any_llm/providers/gemini/utils.py#L572-L581). The caller cannot tell such a stop from a normal one.

any-llm's Gemini provider builds call_{hash(function_call.name)}_{n} ids (providers/gemini/utils.py, non-stream and stream converters) and never reads FunctionCall.id, which google-genai exposes and Gemini sends. The ids also differ between processes because str hash() is salted. Reproduced on 1.33.0 and on main at 18ed82b.

any-llm documents the fallback: Anthropic stop reasons without an OpenAI counterpart (stop_sequence, pause_turn) fall through to stop, and the lookup defaults to stop for any unfamiliar value (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/1.33.0/src/any_llm/providers/anthropic/utils.py#L40-L50, unchanged on main at 18ed82b). The caller cannot tell such a stop from a normal one.

LiteLLM deliberately normalizes unfamiliar finish reasons to stop with a warning. The upstream issue requested that fallback and is closed as completed; 1.105.1 implements it in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/v1.105.1/litellm/litellm_core_utils/core_helpers.py#L253-L258. Gemini and the OpenAI Chat path retain the original in choices[0].provider_specific_fields.native_finish_reason; Anthropic and native Ollama normalize before assigning the choice and lose the original. A raw original does not change the contradictory primary stop.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. LiteLLM deliberately appends __thought__ and the thought signature to the provider's tool-call id for OpenAI client compatibility (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/v1.105.1/litellm/litellm_core_utils/prompt_templates/factory.py#L1163-L1179). Both suite cells preserve names, arguments and the second id, but the first id differs from the wire. The issue tracks interoperability failures caused by this encoding; the shim reports the exposed id unchanged.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Native Ollama sends function.index 0 and 1 in separate chunks; LiteLLM does not lift that field to the delta tool-call index. Delta resets its default index to zero for each chunk, so ordinary index-based assembly merges two argument objects into one unparseable call (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/v1.105.1/litellm/types/utils.py#L1555-L1573). The Ollama parser also replaces the wire ids with UUIDs, reported separately as https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/46543.

A stream that ends cleanly without any finish reason is reported with finish_reason stop. CustomStreamWrapper.finish_reason_handler falls back to stop when no finish reason was received (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/v1.105.1/litellm/litellm_core_utils/streaming_handler.py#L1715-L1727). The Responses path keeps the missing finish and passes.

The native Ollama streaming parser replaces each tool-call id that Ollama sends with a random UUID once the arguments look complete (https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/v1.105.1/litellm/llms/ollama/chat/transformation.py#L480-L489). Separate from the index-0 merge in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/33678; fixing that one alone leaves the ids wrong.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. PR #7096 added opt-in openai_chat_streaming_requires_finish_reason, deliberately retaining the default stop fallback for OpenAI-compatible APIs. In 2.56.0 the suite's default OpenAIProvider and OllamaProvider paths leave that flag false; clean EOF without a finish reason returns stop and a complete ModelResponse. The shim reads the library's response.state, without enabling the optional profile flag. See https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/v2.56.0/pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/profiles/openai.py#L244-L249 and models/openai.py:4502-4513. This is not a default-path fix; the issue was opened on July 20 and the opt-in PR merged on September 2, 2026.
